attachments.document_title: Proof of separate service on the spouse or registered partner (the spouse's own copy with envelope or tracking), or the spouse's statement that no separate copy was received
attachments.label: A1
must_show: addressed to the spouse or registered partner
served separately from the tenant's copy
where the notice followed a payment time limit (art. 257d): the separately served copy of that time limit
attachments.text:
Erlenhof Management Ltd
Langenthal

Mr Ian Suter
Bahnhofstrasse 86
4900 Langenthal

Langenthal, 23 June 2026

Termination of the lease for the flat at Bahnhofstrasse 86, Langenthal

Dear Mr Suter,

As the spouse of our tenant, Ms Tara Kuhn, we hereby inform you that the lease for the family flat at Bahnhofstrasse 86, 2nd floor, is terminated with effect from 31 December 2026. The termination is made on the official form approved by the Canton of Bern, a copy of which is enclosed.

Yours faithfully,
Erlenhof Management Ltd
Kate Bucher

attachments.document_title: Correspondence on the tenant's claims and the landlord's reasons for the notice
attachments.label: A2
must_show: claims the tenant asserted (for example a repair demand or a rent challenge), with dates
the reasons the landlord gave for the notice (on the notice, or given on request)
conciliation or court documents on those claims, if any
attachments.text:
Tara Kuhn to Erlenhof Management Ltd, Ms Kate Bucher
Langenthal, 13 June 2024
The living-room balcony door no longer closes properly. Water comes in when it rains and there is a strong draught. I ask you to have it repaired as soon as possible.

Tara Kuhn to Erlenhof Management Ltd, Ms Kate Bucher
Langenthal, 28 December 2024
The balcony door has still not been repaired. I ask for a reduction of the rent of CHF 185 per month until the repair is done.

Erlenhof Management Ltd, Kate Bucher, to Tara Kuhn
Langenthal, 6 July 2026
You asked us for the reasons for the termination of 23 June 2026. After the numerous complaints and demands of the past two years, we consider that the relationship of trust between landlord and tenant no longer exists. We therefore wish to end the tenancy.

questions.label: Q1
questions.question: Has the landlord given the tenant notice terminating the lease of the dwelling, and has it reached the tenant?

questions.label: Q2
questions.question: Does the claim state that the tenant is married or in a registered partnership and that the rented dwelling serves as the family home?

questions.label: Q3
questions.question: Does the notice or the claim state that the landlord terminated because the tenant did not pay overdue rent or accessory charges within a time limit the landlord had set?

questions.label: Q4
questions.question: Does the tenant seek an extension of the lease because having to leave by the end date would be a hardship for the tenant or the tenant's family?

questions.label: Q5
questions.question: Does the claim state that the landlord gave notice because the tenant had, in good faith, asserted claims under the lease (for example demanded repair of a defect or contested the rent)?

text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I'm writing because Erlenhof Management Ltd wants to put us out of our flat, and I want to say straight away that this is not about money. We have paid the CHF 2240 every month on time, nobody at Erlenhof has ever sent us a reminder or given us a deadline to pay anything, and the termination doesn't claim otherwise.

I'm attaching the copy of the termination that was addressed to my husband.

The real story is this. In June 2024 I asked Ms Kate Bucher in writing to finally repair the balcony door, which doesn't close properly and lets in water and cold air. Nothing happened, so in December 2024 I asked for a reduction of the rent until it was repaired. These were honest requests about a real problem; we just wanted the flat in the state we pay for. Ms Bucher was annoyed both times. When I asked her why we were being given notice, her answer was that the "relationship of trust" had broken down because of our "constant complaints". So she is getting rid of us because we asked for the repair. That is how I see it, and I don't think it is fair.

Ian Suter and I are married. We moved into the flat at Bahnhofstrasse 86 in Langenthal together in July 2022, and it is our family home, where we live as a couple and where our life is.

I also attach my letters to Erlenhof and Ms Bucher's reply.

The notice itself, dated 23 June 2026, reached me by registered post the same day. I signed for it at the door.

I would like to know whether we can challenge this notice and what we need to do.

Yours sincerely,
Tara Kuhn
